name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-04-01.50.1) introduced by Queensland Senator [Matthew Canavan](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/matthew_canavan) (LNP), which means they failed. These amendments were on the subject of creating a temporary freeze in indexation for tap spirits and a review of the alcohol excise and customs tariff system. ### Amendment text The [amendment text](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-04-01.50.1) is available on openaustralia.org.au.
